data.content_ref: inline:Shared mechanism: SRC_013's edge-node expansion and SRC_003's validity_node closure share the mechanism of making warrant provenance attackable, both converting 'attack the warrant' into a graph-level move rather than a meta-level one. Refuted if a graph exists where the closure rule materializes a carriage edge whose warrant the edge-node expansion labels OUT because the warrant's attacker is accepted, so the two constructions disagree on whether the target is refuted.
